channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period: outside capital continues to commit to Puerto Rico, led by Aman's Amantaru resort within the $2B+ Esencia development in Cabo Rojo, Aerostar's $173M airport parking structure, a federally funded 168-room Hyatt Place in Ponce, and Aeroméxico/Delta's new Mexico City–San Juan route starting June 2027. KPS Capital's $2.68B purchase of MM Packaging, which has two Puerto Rico plants, and a $19.56M Army contract for military facilities also stand out. Risks: the New York Fed and the Oversight Board symposium describe an economy that has barely grown in two years with unemployment at 6.2%. Genera expects high outage rates through fiscal 2030, and the AAPP is pressing LUMA over about $1B in unexecuted spending.
